item.frontierhunts.shooting_sticks.desc1: A tripod rest for your rifle, shotgun or handgun.
item.frontierhunts.shooting_sticks.desc2: Use on the ground to set them up (sneak: kneeling height). Use with an empty hand to change the height.
item.frontierhunts.shooting_sticks.desc3: Walk up with your gun and use them: it lies in the yoke, the sway is almost gone and the kick settles back.
item.frontierhunts.shooting_sticks.desc4: Sneak, jump or step away to come off. Sneak + use, or punch them, to fold them up.

guide.frontierhunts.lesson.shot.p5: Steady first. Crouching cuts the sway of your aim. Lying prone (%s) takes almost all of it away, and a fitted Bipod unfolds to rest the rifle. Standing in brush too tall to go prone? Set up Shooting Sticks and lay the gun in the yoke.
guide.frontierhunts.lesson.tips.steady.b: Crouch to cut the sway of your aim. Better still, press %s to go prone: lying flat, almost all the sway is gone, a fitted Bipod unfolds to rest the rifle, and the kick is much smaller. Press it again to get up. Where you can't lie down, use Shooting Sticks (Frontier Workbench): set them up, walk up with your gun and use them. The gun rests in the yoke, the reticle only moves with your breathing and pulse, the wind can't push it, and you swivel it to follow the animal. Sneak to stand up again.
